title: Uniform weight halves with each added coordinate
statement: For every natural number $n$, the uniform weight $2^{-n}$ assigned to each point of $\{0,1\}^n$ satisfies \[2^{-(n+1)} = \frac{2^{-n}}{2},\] so that the uniform weight on the cube of one higher dimension is half the uniform weight on the original cube.
